observed_original_abi.return_conflict: Ghidra reports bool, but the live machine writes the matched node value through [EAX] and returns zero on the sentinel path. The staging signature preserves the machine pointer return and records the SDK label without promoting the decompiler bool guess.

search_order: scan forward from bucket zero until a non-null bucket entry
compare the first entry with the bucket-count sentinel
for each node compare node key with the requested dword
on a miss follow node next, then advance to the next non-null bucket
return the sentinel as a miss
